title: I allocated $3B to quant hedge funds. Yesterday I researched strategies live with AI tools. Today at 3:30pm ET I start building the first one.
author: stoaphil
selftext:
Some background if you missed yesterday's post: I used to be head PM at an allocator, picking and monitoring mostly quantitative hedge funds, with about $3B under management. I'm a CFA charterholder and I've sat through hundreds of quant manager pitches.

Now I'm trying to build a systematic fund myself, one person with AI coding tools, on stream.

Yesterday was research. We went through a long list of strategy ideas and tested them. Most of the ones that looked great at first fell apart once we checked them properly: short samples, math mistakes, one lucky period. That was the most useful part of the day.

Today we start implementing the strategy that held up. I'll talk through it the way I would if a manager pitched it to me, including the parts I'd push back on.

The stream itself is run by an AI agent (OBS, health checks, recording), so you'll see some of that too.

Live today at 3:30pm ET (12:30pm PT, 8:30pm UK):

Twitch: [twitch.tv/sudomyshkin](http://twitch.tv/sudomyshkin)

YouTube: [youtube.com/@sudomyshkin/live](http://youtube.com/@sudomyshkin/live)

Questions welcome in chat, especially skeptical ones. Not investment advice, not raising money.
